source.kaggle_context: Kaggle v12 timed out and v13 was blocked by weekly GPU quota, so this run used the approved remote L20 GPU.

scope.purpose: Arabic-only MIRACL reranking comparison against the completed E5 v13 diagnostic.

interpretation: BGE-M3 completes the Arabic MIRACL reranking subset with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.792010.
On this harder Arabic MIRACL subset, BGE-M3 beats E5 by +0.017040 nDCG@10 and is also higher on MAP@10, MRR@10, recall@10, precision@10, and hit_rate@10.
BGE-M3 is slightly slower than E5 on the same remote L20 setup: about 47.01 minutes versus 44.95 minutes.
The reranking conclusion is now task-dependent: E5 clearly wins Namaa reranking, while BGE-M3 leads the Arabic MIRACL slice.
This is still baseline evidence, not an Arabic embedding SOTA claim.
next_experiment: Run MIRACLReranking eval_subsets=['ar'] for Omartificial-Intelligence-Space/Arabic-Triplet-Matryoshka-V2 on the remote L20 GPU to complete the three-model MIRACL Arabic reranking comparison.
